# ModPatch CLI provenance

ModLaunch invokes the plain .NET 6 CLI from [AnomalyLabsIO/SCPSL-ModPatch](https://github.com/AnomalyLabsIO/SCPSL-ModPatch), forked from [hopperlopip/SCPSL-ModPatch](https://github.com/hopperlopip/SCPSL-ModPatch) (MIT, Copyright 2024 LostFire). The GUI and console projects compile the same command implementation and patch engine. ModLaunch no longer maintains copies of the patch resolver, method mapper, or offset patches.

`SCPSL-ModPatch.Cli-win-x64.zip` contains the CLI, `patchinfo.json`, clean launchers, and `bundle.json`. The inventory identifies the repository, base commit, exact source-archive SHA-256, and individual binary/resource hashes. The source archive is authoritative when the checkout includes unpublished changes; the base commit alone does not represent those changes. Both archives have SHA-256 sidecars enforced during packaging. Runtime validation checks the inventory before invoking the CLI. These checks detect corruption, not a compromised publisher.

`SCPSL-ModPatch.Cli-sources.zip` contains the corresponding fork source, dependency binaries, manifests, clean launchers, tests, and packaging script. It accompanies release output. Rebuild with its `scripts/package-cli.ps1`, passing `-SourceRevision` from `bundle.json` when using an exported archive. Refresh the pinned packages using ModLaunch's `scripts/import-modpatch.ps1 -SourceRoot <fork checkout>`.

The integration requests `--metadata-mode preserve` and lets ModPatch determine the initial parser configuration from Unity identity, then select the complete target from original DLL hash/version. The CLI reports parser identity, selected profile index, patch outcomes, and before/after hashes. ModLaunch independently verifies the expected changes and requires runtime metadata to remain original. It rejects incomplete results and unsupported manifest syntax before activating any live file.

The fork's current CLI dependencies include Il2CppDumper and Mono.Cecil from its `SCPSL ModPatch/Il2CppDumper/` directory, Iced 1.21.0, Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3, and System.IO.Hashing 9.0.5. Original projects: [Il2CppDumper](https://github.com/Perfare/Il2CppDumper), [Mono.Cecil](https://github.com/jbevain/cecil); both MIT. License texts are retained here and in the packaged notices. The CLI package does not include FASM; definitions that need it fail explicitly.

`MetadataHeaderNormalizer.cs` and `MelonInteropAssemblyGenerator.cs` remain GPL-3.0-or-later ModLaunch components for the Cpp2IL/Il2CppInterop preparation path. Runtime metadata is never rewritten. The Unity bundle-version correction and transactional session lifecycle also remain ModLaunch responsibilities.

Cpp2IL `2022.1.0-pre-release.21` and its StrippedCodeRegSupport plugin are fetched from the pinned release; SHA-256 digests from the GitHub release API are embedded in the helper. Unity managed libraries use a Unity-version-specific release and enforce a published digest when available; older releases lack upstream digests, so downloads are cached with a local SHA-256.
